text: GitHub Trending Radar 是面向 DSH Web 的 GitHub 趋势发现插件：抓取日榜、周榜或月榜，可按编程语言筛选，并把热门仓库整理为带分类、技术栈、star 增长和项目摘要的分析报告。它向 DSH 注册 github_trending 工具与 /github-trending 命令，并在侧边栏提供可搜索、分类筛选和分页的仓库卡片面板；报告还包含汇总指标与图表数据。适合希望跟踪开源项目热度、按技术方向浏览 GitHub 新项目的开发者。可选配置 GITHUB_TOKEN 或 GH_TOKEN 来补充仓库元数据；基础榜单无需 token。

GitHub Trending Radar fetches daily, weekly, or monthly GitHub boards by language and summarizes repository categories, stacks, and star growth. Its DSH tool, slash command, and Web sidebar panel provide searchable, filterable, paginated reports. An optional GitHub token enriches repository details.
想按日榜、周榜或月榜查看最近走红的 GitHub 项目。
能不能按 Python、Rust 之类的语言筛选 GitHub Trending？
我想快速比较热门仓库的 star 增长和项目技术栈。
让 DSH 帮我整理一份可浏览的 GitHub 趋势报告。
有没有办法在 Harness 侧边栏搜索和筛选趋势仓库？
想了解本周 GitHub 上哪些开源项目正在升温。
Show me trending GitHub repositories for a chosen programming language.
I want a dashboard to compare recent repository growth and technology stacks.
GitHub Trending Radar 的功能「周期与语言榜单」：抓取 GitHub 日榜、周榜或月榜，并可选择编程语言；工具、命令和面板都能指定筛选条件，结果整理为仓库列表。
GitHub Trending Radar 的功能「仓库结构化分析」：为榜单项目汇总简介、star 增长、分类和推断技术栈，并结合可获取的仓库资料生成亮点与摘要。通过报告抓取后自动生成。
GitHub Trending Radar 的功能「交互式 Web 报告」：在 DSH 侧边栏打开仓库卡片面板，可切换周期、筛选语言与分类、搜索并翻页；面板从同源报告接口加载数据。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · GitHub 趋势雷达 · dsh-github-trending：[中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)

一个可长期安装的 Cordis 插件：抓取 GitHub Trending 日榜 / 周榜 / 月榜（支持按编程语言筛选），
对每个仓库做结构化分析（项目简介、star 增量、核心技术栈、亮点、风险点），
并在 Harness Web UI 里渲染成可浏览、可翻页、可筛选的卡片报告；同时注册工具、命令与 HTTP 路由。

> 关于「dsh-genui」：本 Harness 版本中并不存在名为 `dsh-genui` 的包或服务（已核对 199 个已装配配置项与 host/client 服务目录）。
> 因此本插件自带一套生成式 UI 渲染层：host 侧输出结构化报告数据，client 侧注入 `sidebar.panellist` 图标 + `main` 面板，
> 由 React 组件渲染卡片与分页，效果等同「调用一个 genui 渲染卡片页面」，且不依赖任何未安装的包。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 功能：- **榜单抓取**：`daily` / `weekly` / `monthly` 三个周期，23 种常用编程语言筛选；解析 star 总数、fork、周期增量、贡献者、语言色。
- **结构化分析**（确定性规则引擎，不额外调用模型）：
  - 项目简介（官方 description + README 摘要清洗）
  - star 增量、周期增长率、日均新增、基数对比
  - 核心技术栈（语言 → 生态、topics → 技术映射、名称/简介/README 关键词）
  - 项目亮点（排名、增速、体量、赛道、贡献者、许可证、活跃度）
  - 风险点与风险等级（star 基数偏小、增速过热、项目过新、归档、license 缺失、issue 积压、单点维护、信息缺失）
  - 分类（AI / 大模型、开发者工具、Web、基础设施、数据、安全、移动、区块链、学习、效率、其他）
- **交互式报告面板**：侧边栏「GitHub 趋势」图标 → 主面板卡片页，含 KPI 概览、周期切换、语言下拉、搜索、分类筛选、
  仓库卡片分页（每页 6 条，卡片直接展示头像、排名、简介、指标、标签与整段分析）。页面只保留这些内容，
  条形图、独立的深度解读专区、图表源码与下载入口都不占版面。
- **报告数据**：`xychart-beta` 增量柱状图与 `pie` 占比的 Mermaid 源码，连同结构化仓库数据一起由
  `GET /dsh-github-trending/report` 的 JSON 返回，供脚本或二次渲染使用；面板本身不展示这些源码。
- **多入口**：工具 `github_trending`、命令 `/github-trending [daily|weekly|monthly] [language]`、`GET /dsh-github-trending/report`。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 安装：在 DSH 中把本目录安装为 bundle：

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="<绝对路径>/dsh-github-trending")
```

安装会把包写入当前 profile 的 `package.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`（`- insert: - id: dsh-github-trending`），
并在 Harness Web UI 中生效：侧边栏出现「GitHub 趋势」面板入口，工具列表出现 `github_trending`，命令面板出现 `/github-trending`。

也可以把本包当作普通 Cordis 插件手动加载，参考 `cordis.yml`。

从 GitHub 安装（仓库根目录即包根，无需构建脚本）：

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="github:Royalsan/dsh-github-trending")
```

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 安装：从 npm 安装（已发布到 npm registry，无需 git 与构建）：

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="@royalsan/dsh-github-trending")
```

从 GitHub Release 的预构建 tarball 安装（不拉源码、不跑构建，适合网络受限时）：

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="https://github.com/Royalsan/dsh-github-trending/releases/latest/download/dsh-github-trending.tgz")
```

三种来源装的是同一份编译产物；npm 方式走 profile 配置的 registry，国内镜像未同步时可能晚几分钟到几小时。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 配置：`apply(ctx, config)` 支持以下字段（均有默认值）：

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | string | `$GITHUB_TOKEN` / `$GH_TOKEN` | 可选 GitHub token，用于提升 API 限额（未认证 60 次/小时）。**不要把 token 写进仓库**，用环境变量传入即可 |
| `defaultSince` | `daily`\|`weekly`\|`monthly` | `daily` | 工具/命令未指定周期时使用 |
| `defaultLimit` | number | `15` | 抓取条数（3–25） |
| `defaultFocus` | number | `3` | 深度融合解读的仓库数（1–6） |

在 `cordis.yml` / bundle patch 里写 `config:` 即可覆盖；`token` 建议留给环境变量。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 使用：```text
/github-trending                       # 今日榜，全语言
/github-trending weekly rust           # 周榜，Rust
```

工具调用等价于：

```json
{ "since": "weekly", "language": "rust", "limit": 20, "focus": 4, "refresh": false }
```

HTTP 路由（同源，供面板与外部脚本使用）：

```text
GET /dsh-github-trending/report?since=daily&language=&limit=15&focus=3&refresh=0
```

返回报告 JSON：`since` / `language` / `generatedAt` / `repos[]`（含分析字段）/ `summary` / `mermaid`。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 使用：缓存：报告 10 分钟（同一周期的并发请求会合并），GitHub API 事实 6 小时；命中 403/429 后 5 分钟内跳过增强，
页面仍可用 Trending 页面本身的数据渲染。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 结构：```
index.js            Host 侧：工具、命令、HTTP 路由（apply 注册，ctx.effect 清理）
client.js           客户端：sidebar.panellist 图标 + main 面板组件（window.__ModuleLoader__）
lib/trending.js     Trending HTML 抓取与解析
lib/http.js         传输层：直连 fetch + Harness web 服务回退

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 开发：```powershell
node build.mjs                 # src/**.ts → 同名 .js
node test/smoke-host.mjs daily # 宿主端：工具/命令/路由端到端
node test/smoke-client.mjs daily rust   # 客户端：用 React shim 渲染面板并断言
node test/make-preview.mjs daily        # 把面板快照包成可独立打开的预览页

`test/out/` 下会生成面板 HTML 快照、布局指标与预览图（`panel-*.html` / `panel-*.png`），便于离线检查排版。
预览页用 `--dsw-alias-*` 的回退取值渲染，不依赖 Harness 外壳；布局自检会回传 `overflowX`、卡片列数、KPI 数量等指标，用来发现横向溢出之类的问题。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 说明：- 数据来源为 `github.com/trending` 页面（榜单项数量随 GitHub 返回变化，通常 10–16 条）。
- star 增量为页面给出的周期内新增值；分析文案由规则引擎生成，用于快速筛选，不构成选型或投资建议。
- 未认证时 GitHub API 限额较低，插件会自动降级：仅缺失 topics/license/issue/README 等增强信息，核心榜单与增长率不受影响。
- 网络受限环境下，如果直连 `github.com` 失败，插件会回退到 Harness 自身配置的 web 传输通道（`ctx.web.fetch`）。
@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · 许可：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · GitHub Trending Radar · dsh-github-trending：[中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)

A long-lived Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it scrapes GitHub Trending (daily / weekly / monthly, optionally filtered
by programming language), runs a structured analysis on every repository (summary, star growth, tech stack, highlights,
risks), and renders the result as a browsable, pageable, filterable card report inside the Harness Web UI. It also
registers a tool, a slash command and an HTTP route.

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · GitHub Trending Radar · dsh-github-trending：> About "dsh-genui": no package or service named `dsh-genui` exists in this Harness build (verified against all 199 live
> configuration entries and the host/client service catalog). The plugin therefore ships its own generative-UI layer: the
> host returns structured report data, and the client injects a `sidebar.panellist` entry plus a `main` panel whose React
> component renders the cards. The result is equivalent to a genui card page without depending on anything uninstalled.

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Features：- **Trending scraping**: `daily` / `weekly` / `monthly`, 23 common languages; parses total stars, forks, period gain, contributors and language color.
- **Structured analysis** (deterministic rules, no extra model calls):
  - project summary (official description plus a cleaned README excerpt)
  - star gain, period growth ratio, average stars per day, base-size comparison
  - inferred stack (language ecosystem, topic-to-technology mapping, name/description/README keywords)
  - highlights (rank, momentum, scale, category, contributors, license, activity)
  - risks with a severity level (small base, overheated growth, very new project, archived, missing license, issue backlog,
    single-maintainer risk, missing information)
  - category (AI/LLM, developer tooling, Web, infrastructure, data, security, mobile, blockchain, learning, productivity, other)
- **Interactive report panel**: the "GitHub Trending" sidebar icon opens a main panel with KPI tiles, a period switch, a
  language selector, search, category chips and paginated repo cards (6 per page; each card shows the owner avatar, rank,
  description, metrics, tags and the full analy

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Install：Install this directory as a bundle in DSH:

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="<absolute path>/dsh-github-trending")
```

The install writes the package into the profile's `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`
(`- insert: - id: dsh-github-trending`) and takes effect in the Harness Web UI: a "GitHub Trending" sidebar entry appears,
`github_trending` shows up in the tool list, and `/github-trending` in the command palette.

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Install：You can also mount it as an ordinary Cordis plugin by hand; see `cordis.yml`.

Installing straight from GitHub (the repository root is the package root, and no build step is required):

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="github:Royalsan/dsh-github-trending")
```

From npm (published to the npm registry; no git and no build step):

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="@royalsan/dsh-github-trending")
```

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Install：From the prebuilt tarball attached to a GitHub Release (no clone, no build — handy behind a flaky network):

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="https://github.com/Royalsan/dsh-github-trending/releases/latest/download/dsh-github-trending.tgz")
```

All three sources install the same compiled files; the npm route goes through the registry configured for the profile,
so a mirror that has not synced yet may lag by minutes to hours.

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Configuration：| Field | Type | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | string | `$GITHUB_TOKEN` / `$GH_TOKEN` | Optional GitHub token that raises the API quota (60 requests/hour unauthenticated). **Never commit a token**; pass it through the environment |
| `defaultSince` | `daily`\|`weekly`\|`monthly` | `daily` | Period used when the tool or command omits one |
| `defaultLimit` | number | `15` | Repositories to scrape (3–25) |
| `defaultFocus` | number | `3` | Repositories that get the extended deep-dive (1–6) |
@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Configuration：Set them under `config:` in `cordis.yml` or the bundle patch; prefer an environment variable for `token`.

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Usage：```text
/github-trending                       # today, all languages
/github-trending weekly rust           # this week, Rust
```

The equivalent tool call:

```json
{ "since": "weekly", "language": "rust", "limit": 20, "focus": 4, "refresh": false }
```

HTTP route (same origin, used by the panel and by scripts):

```text
GET /dsh-github-trending/report?since=daily&language=&limit=15&focus=3&refresh=0
```

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Layout：```
index.js            host side: tool, command, HTTP routes (registered in apply, disposed via ctx.effect)
client.js           client side: sidebar.panellist icon + main panel component (window.__ModuleLoader__)
lib/trending.js     GitHub Trending HTML fetching and parsing
lib/http.js         transport: direct fetch with a Harness web-service fallback

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Development：```powershell
node build.mjs                 # src/**.ts -> sibling .js
node test/smoke-host.mjs daily # host: tool/command/route end to end
node test/smoke-client.mjs daily rust   # client: render the panel through a React shim and assert
node test/make-preview.mjs daily        # wrap the panel snapshot into a standalone preview page

@royalsan/dsh-github-trending README · Notes：- Data comes from the `github.com/trending` page; the number of rows varies with GitHub's response (usually 10–16).
- The star gain is the period gain GitHub reports. Analysis text is rule-generated to speed up triage and is not a
  recommendation.
- The unauthenticated API quota is low, so enrichment degrades gracefully: only topics/license/issues/README extras are
  missing; the ranking and growth numbers are unaffected.
- On a restricted network, when a direct connection to `github.com` fails the plugin falls back to the Harness web
  transport (`ctx.web.fetch`).
